threat_event: Attacker or insider changes PLC setpoints or recipes (for example blanching temperature or metal detector reject settings) and adulterated product ships
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vulnerability assessments do not consider cyber changes to process controls; change logging on lines is local
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (no control system scenario in the assessments); EV-060 (line change logs kept locally); EV-089 (qualified individual interviews)
existing_controls: Plant OT monitoring; physical access to lines; verification sampling
treatment_plan: Reanalyze vulnerability assessments with cyber scenarios; restrict and log setpoint changes; integrity checks on critical PLCs
owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

threat_event: Compromise of ammonia refrigeration controls causes a release or loss of cold storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Refrigeration contractor remote access through PAM; session recordings not reviewed
likelihood_basis: EV-061 (contractor sessions through PAM; changes outside management of change); EV-081 (recordings not reviewed)
existing_controls: Group PAM with MFA; licensed operators on site; mechanical relief and detection systems
treatment_plan: Review all contractor sessions weekly; approval per session; alarm on mode changes
owner: Food Processing plant OT security manager

threat_event: Electronic monitoring records that food safety plans rely on are altered or lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records locked after sign-off in the quality service, but line data historians are editable
likelihood_basis: EV-059 (line historians allow operator edits); EV-090 (no change history on historian values)
treatment_plan: Lock historian data used as records; monthly integrity review
owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

threat_event: Ransomware on plant MES and OT halts production lines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MES servers share domain trust with plant IT
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (MES domain trusts the plant IT domain)
existing_controls: EDR; OT monitoring; versioned PLC backups
treatment_plan: Separate MES domain; quarterly MES restore tests
owner: Food Processing plant OT security manager

threat_event: Traceability records cannot be produced within 24 hours of an FDA request during an outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dependence on the Crop Farming nightly file and on the traceability system; never drilled during an outage
likelihood_basis: EV-062 (no mock recall with systems down); EV-045 (nightly file dependency)
treatment_plan: Quarterly 24-hour records drill; offline lot ledger at each facility
owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

threat_event: Corrupted or missing harvest lot file creates wrong lot links
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No integrity check on the nightly file
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (no integrity check on the nightly file)
treatment_plan: Signed manifests and control totals on the feed
owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

threat_event: Food defense plan details leak and help an attacker target actionable process steps
treatment_plan: Restrict to qualified individuals and plant managers (38 users)
owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; portal delivery planned 2027

threat_event: Retail and foodservice 24-hour notice commitments missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer notice terms not in the incident matrix
likelihood_basis: EV-065 (customer 24-hour terms); EV-012 (not in the matrix)
owner: Food Processing security and compliance lead

threat_event: FAR 52.204-21 safeguarding requirements not met on systems that hold USDA contract information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Requirements not mapped to group controls
affected_asset_or_process: ERP and email holding contract data
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (requirements not mapped to group controls)
existing_controls: Group controls largely cover the 15 requirements
owner: Food Processing security and compliance lead

threat_event: Covered telecommunications or video surveillance equipment found in a plant camera system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Camera systems at 3 older plants installed before group procurement rules
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (camera systems at 3 older plants predate screening)
treatment_plan: Inventory review of camera systems; report within 1 business day if found
owner: Food Processing security and compliance lead

threat_event: Production plans built on unvalidated yield forecasts cause over- or under-staffing and waste
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Production planning uses AI-001 estimates directly
likelihood_basis: EV-033 (AI-005 uses AI-001 estimates); EV-054 (no validation record)

threat_event: Unsupported HMIs on older lines are exploited
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (12 HMIs past end of support)
owner: Food Processing plant OT security manager

threat_event: WMS outage stops frozen and fresh-cut shipments
treatment_plan: Tested paper shipping procedure each quarter

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects grower payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many outside growers; bank change requests by email
existing_controls: Callback rule for supplier bank changes
treatment_plan: Extend the callback rule to grower settlements

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lab portal accounts shared by quality teams
likelihood_basis: EV-081 (shared laboratory portal accounts); EV-027 (laboratory SOC 2 report)
owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality

threat_event: Plant OT monitoring misses attacks on a new line
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: New lines added without sensor coverage review
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (sensors at all 11 facilities); EV-081 (new lines without coverage review)
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; sensor coverage in the new-line checklist
owner: Food Processing plant OT security manager

threat_event: Food Traceability Rule key data elements cannot be produced as an electronic sortable spreadsheet within 24 hours once enforced
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Current traceability system does not hold all key data elements
likelihood_basis: EV-062 (readiness note on key data elements)
treatment_plan: Gap assessment and system changes before 2028-07-20
owner: Food Processing VP Food Safety and Quality
